title: An ended form leaves growth room

captions.physics: Ending an exhausted way of caring
captions.energy: Supporting openness to a good possibility

meaning: Your care can give growth room when ending unnecessary help keeps hope open without requiring immediate success.
text: Acceptance can become more spacious after a role that no longer fits ends. In the physical position of Anahata, Death expresses care through ending an exhausted form of involvement and moving towards another. The Star in energy brings a wish to preserve an open, good possibility without guaranteeing a result. The Empress in emotions offers generous warmth and room for growth. Tenderness may come from a new wish not needing former dependence for expression. Help stays available without requiring someone to remain a beginner for attention or become skilled immediately after it ends.

For example, one person no longer wants the other continually to correct small pottery pieces before firing. You end that habit and leave materials accessible for individual trials. **Ending unnecessary help can leave growth free.** An uneven cup receives a place without compulsory improvement. Warmth stays in kind interest and concrete help on request rather than promised future mastery.

Hope can become a concealed expectation of correct development. Ending help turns into an examination, and acceptance depends on success. Alternatively, generosity takes the entire process over again at the first mistake. Care preserves a freely given response. An old form can end, a new request be accepted and neither dependence nor flawless independence made a condition of warm regard for a person.
